races.paceDynamic: Miss Doyenne and Hathaways Cottage are both confirmed front-runners who will contest the early lead, creating an honest gallop from the start. With 17 runners over 2m4f, the pace will be solid throughout as these two prominent types stretch the field early. The sustained pace will test stamina reserves, particularly with multiple hurdles to negotiate over this trip. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and those with proven staying power who can benefit from the strong early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Doyenne and Hathaways Cottage both go forward aggressively from the start
scenarios.body: The dual pace-setters create an honest tempo that stretches the field and sets up a stamina test. Hold-up horses like Cool Native and Infinity Succes can benefit from the strong gallop and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners takes a lead while the other settles
scenarios.body: A more measured pace allows prominent runners to stay closer to the action throughout. This suits horses like Whispering Hopes and Lady Cosmo who can track the pace and have tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hathaways Cottage Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Hathaways Cottage gets an uncontested lead with Miss Doyenne settling behind
scenarios.body: The experienced pointer could steal a march if allowed easy fractions up front. This would disadvantage hold-up horses who need a stronger pace to close into.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jumping Errors Disrupt
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or mistakes occur at the hurdles in a competitive field
scenarios.body: The race becomes a survival test where clean jumping becomes paramount over pure ability. This favours the more experienced hurdlers who can avoid trouble.

watchPoints.text: Miss Doyenne and Hathaways Cottage both going forward early could create unsustainable fractions that compromise both
Cool Native's quick 8-day turnaround after Navan debut could indicate either confidence or desperation from connections
Infinity Succes showed early promise on hurdle debut but regressed in bumpers so needs to recapture that form
Several horses with pull-up form including The Poet's Way and Hathaways Cottage pose reliability concerns in large field
Three debutants including Likeyouhaveplenty and Creevybeg represent unknown quantities with potential market moves

races.paceDynamic: Brother Hollie is the clear pace angle with his prominent style, likely to lead or sit close early with minimal pressure from this field. Circus Act and Party Pack may track him, but neither shows strong early pace, allowing Brother Hollie to dictate terms through steady fractions. The lack of genuine speed horses means this will develop into a tactical affair with the pace quickening late as the hold-up horses like Dairy Force and Kalsman make their moves. This controlled tempo strongly favours horses with finishing kicks who can sit off the pace and pounce late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Hold-Up Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Brother Hollie sets uncontested fractions and the pace is steady throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows hold-up horses to get into perfect striking positions, with the race becoming a sprint finish over the final 3 furlongs. Patient tactics triumph as horses with closing ability sweep past the early leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Brother Hollie gets easy fractions and maintains his position turning for home
scenarios.body: The prominent runner takes advantage of the weak pace by staying clear of trouble and having enough left to resist late challenges. His tactical speed proves decisive when others are making ground too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders quicken significantly approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: A sudden increase in tempo catches some hold-up horses flat-footed and sets up horses positioned in midfield or tracking the pace. Those who anticipated the move benefit while pure hold-up horses struggle to close.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Brother Hollie goes too slow and multiple horses challenge simultaneously at the final flight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish with little to choose between several horses, favouring those with the most natural speed regardless of early position. Form horses with proven finishing speed edge out the battlers.

watchPoints.text: Brother Hollie could steal this if allowed to dictate his own fractions without early pressure
Dairy Force's hold-up style perfectly suits the likely pace scenario but needs clean passage
Kalsman has strong course form and the race shape should play to his late-running style
Circus Act's 40-day break could blunt her finishing kick despite winning this race previously
Several horses carry fade-in-finish warnings which could be crucial in a tactical finish

races.paceDynamic: Hitthehayson will take this field along as the sole confirmed front-runner, with Irish Champ, Jukebox Johnny, Stardhem and Couldntmakeitup forming a prominent group tracking the leader. The large hold-up contingent including Spellacy's Cross, King Gris, Only For Our Man and Mistyburn will give this race a strong gallop throughout the 2m6f trip. With only one horse committed to making the running, Hitthehayson can dictate terms without pressure, creating a searching pace that will test stamina reserves. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can track the pace and kick when it counts, as the hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage with limited early pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group can sit comfortably behind Hitthehayson's controlled gallop
scenarios.body: Irish Champ, Stardhem, Jukebox Johnny and Couldntmakeitup will have ideal positioning to strike in the straight when the pace quickens. The hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground with insufficient early pace to close into.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Lasts
scenarios.trigger: If Hitthehayson gets an easy lead and maintains strong stamina reserves for the finish
scenarios.body: The 7-year-old can use his tactical advantage to stay clear of the field, particularly given his recent good form and light weight. His sustainable pace-setting style suits the 2m6f distance perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Revival Late
scenarios.trigger: If several hold-up horses can get competitive positions mid-race despite the tactical setup
scenarios.body: King Gris and Spellacy's Cross may find enough pace to aim at, with their class shining through in the final furlong. The Gordon Elliott and James Barcoe horses both have the ability to overcome tactical disadvantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely or there are significant jumping errors affecting the main contenders
scenarios.body: Dark Lieutenant or Rough 'n' Smooth could benefit from a messy race that doesn't go to script. Both have shown glimpses of ability but need everything to fall their way.

watchPoints.text: Hitthehayson must be watched for any early mistakes at hurdles that could disrupt his tactical advantage as lone leader
Several hold-up horses including King Gris and Spellacy's Cross need to be positioned closer than usual given the limited early pace
Irish Champ and Stardhem are both prominent runners who could benefit most from tracking Hitthehayson's controlled gallop
The ground conditions favour King Gris less than his recent wins suggests, having won on heavy/testing surfaces recently
Jukebox Johnny represents the Henry De Bromhead yard who have a strong 14-day record compared to several unsuccessful trainers

races.paceDynamic: Sphagnum and Knocknagoran Lady are the only prominent runners in a field dominated by hold-up horses, creating a very moderate early tempo over this extended 3m trip. With limited pace pressure, the leaders can dictate terms and maintain energy for the business end, while the large pack of hold-up horses will need to rely on stamina and finishing kick from off the pace. Artic Chief may also press forward early but has a history of fading in the finish. This race shape strongly favours the prominent/leading horses who can control the gallop and kick clear when the hold-up brigade are still trying to get organized in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Advantage Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Sphagnum and Knocknagoran Lady get an easy lead and soft fractions through the early stages
scenarios.body: They can save energy for a sustained drive from the front while the hold-up horses struggle to make up significant ground from too far back. The prominent pair kick clear in the straight before the closers can mount their challenge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace allows the better hold-up horses to get into contention turning for home
scenarios.body: The stamina-laden hold-up types benefit from the soft early gallop and produce strong late runs to reel in the leaders. Quality horses like Cozone and John Storey use their class to prevail.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Sphagnum and the prominent runners go too slowly and create a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble with multiple horses still in with chances at the last hurdle. Hold-up horses with tactical speed like Joya Del Mar and Coppola can capitalize on the chaos.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites fail to handle the tactical nature and moderate gallop of this big field handicap
scenarios.body: A well-handicapped outsider gets the perfect trip tracking the pace and strikes when the market leaders have positioning problems. Duce Bigalow or Head For Home could benefit from the scramble.

races.paceDynamic: Meet And Greet will take them along from the front with no genuine pace pressure in this small field of beginners chasers. The prominent runners Ballybow and Written In My Soul will track the leader, while the hold-up horses Sandor Clegane, Villagers Cross and Astley will need the pace to collapse late. With Meet And Greet able to dictate terms unopposed, this sets up perfectly for the front-runner and prominent racers who can stay in touch throughout. This race shape strongly favours prominent/leading types who can avoid the jumping errors that often plague hold-up horses in beginners chases.

races.paceDynamic: Neon Diamond will set the pace from the front with minimal pressure, as he's the only confirmed front-runner in this 12-runner field. The prominent runners Brucejack, Aclass, The Gradual Slope will sit handy but won't apply serious early pressure over this staying trip. With so many hold-up horses including Gatsby Grey, Hello Jack, Tonaghneave Well, Goody Four Shoes, Beggars Rock, Attaboyarchie and Millie B, the pace will be steady and sustainable through the early stages before quickening from 3 out. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses and patient prominent runners who can finish, as they'll get the perfect tow into the race from the lone leader.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Neon Diamond to dictate throughout and he finds enough in reserve when challenged, with the chasers unable to reel him in despite their finishing kicks. His stamina proves decisive over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.trigger: If the favourites encounter trouble in running or fail to handle the pace dynamics
scenarios.body: A lesser-fancied horse like Reve Inoui or Attaboyarchie benefits from a cleaner passage and improved form, while the market leaders disappoint through poor positioning or below-par performances. The handicap nature allows for surprises.
